name: Godrej Eternal Palms
description: Godrej Eternal Palms is a twin-tower development off Palm Beach Road in Sanpada, Navi Mumbai, set on 1.6 acres. The G+37 towers hold 2 & 3 BHK homes, with only four apartments per floor, above five levels of podium parking and an amenity deck on the sixth level.
curation: A low-density plan, with only four apartments per floor across the twin towers
Amenities over three levels: ground-level gardens, the E-Deck podium with a half-Olympic-length pool, and a rooftop overlooking the Palm Beach mangroves
A design team of Soyuz Talib Architects for architecture, EPLA Studio for landscape, and Open Atelier for interiors
amenities: Open lawns and morning fitness areas
connectivity: 5 min to Sanpada and Vashi railway stations
developerNote: Established in 1990, Godrej Properties is the first real estate company in India to have ISO certification, and is currently developing landmark projects across 15+ cities covering over 21.7 million square metres.
photoDescription: Twin towers above a landscaped podium under a blue sky
